b<5; b++){\n    for(int i=0; i<100; i++){\n      p+=j*d;\n      j=dE(p);\n      if(j<det || length(p)>5.) break;\n      g+=.1/(.1+j*100.);\n    }\n    vec3 N=n(p);\n    if(j<det){\n      p-=d*det*2.;\n      vec3 R=normalize(h3(u+mod(iTime,10.)*.1+N.xy));\n      float rs=dot(N,R)<0.?-1.:1.;\n      d=mix(normalize(R*rs+N),reflect(d,N),.5);\n      if(sp>.01){\n        c-=mod(it,5.)*.1;\n        c.rg*=r(-it*.2);\n        e*=.8;\n      }\n    }\n    if(length(p)>5.) break;\n  }\n  c+=exp(-5.*length(normalize(d+.1).xy))*8.*vec3(1.,.9,.5)*step(0.,-p.z)*e-g*.01;\n  c+=exp(-2.*length(normalize(d-.1).yz))*vec3(0.3,0.9,1.)*e*1.5;\n  return clamp(c,0.,1.);\n}\n\nvoid mainImage(out vec4 F,in vec2 C){\n  vec2 u=C/iResolution.xy-.5;\n  u.x*=iResolution.x/iResolution.y;\n  vec2 t=u+mod(iTime,15.);\n  u.x+=2./iResolution.x*(h(t)-.5);\n  u.y+=2./iResolution.y*(h(t+.564)-.5);\n  vec2 tt=vec2(floor(iTime*.1));\n  vec3 d=normalize(vec3(u,10./(1.+.000*float(iFrame))));\n  vec3 f=vec3(h(tt),h(tt+0.456),-3.);\n  //f.x-=float(iFrame)*.000007;\n  vec3 c=m(f,d);\n  c*=vec3(1.,1.,1.2);\n  c.rb*=r(u.y*.3);\n//  c=mix(c,vec3(.7)*length(c),.3);\n  F=vec4(mix(c,texture(iChannel0,C/iResolution.xy).rgb,.97),1.);\n}\n","name":"Buffer A","description":"","type":"buffer"}]},{"ver":"0.1","info":{"id":"XtX3zj","date":"1379620640","viewed":3801,"name":"Alien Tech","username":"Kali","description":"Someone at Fractal Forums suggested that the word \\\"alien\\\" should be banned from fractal art, but I couldn\\'t resist :).  No rays, just light shading from normals, plane distortion and orbit trap for the yellow lights (and 3x antialiasing)","likes":70,"published":1,"flags":0,"usePreview":0,"tags":[]},"renderpass":[{"inputs":[],"outputs":[{"id":"4dfGRr","channel":0}],"code":"// Alien Tech by Kali\n\n#define SHOWLIGHT //comment this line if you find the moving ligth annoying like Dave :D\n#define BLINKINGLIGHTS 1.\n\n// change this to tweak the fractal\n#define c vec2(2.,4.5) \n\n//other cool params (comment default then uncomment one of this):\n//#define c vec2(1.,5.)\n//#define c vec2(4.,.5)\n//#define c vec2(4.-length(p)*.2)\n//#define c vec2(abs(sin(p.y*2.)),5.) //love this one with blinking\n\n\n#define ti iTime\nvec3 ldir;\nfloat ot;\nfloat blur;\n\n\n// 2D fractal based on Mandelbox\nfloat formula(vec2 p) {\n\tvec2 t = vec2(sin(ti * .3) * .1 + ti * .05, ti * .1); // move fractal\n\tt+= iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;\n\tp=abs(.5 - fract(p * .4 + t)) * 1.3; // tiling\n\tot=1000.; \n\tfloat l, expsmo;\n\tfloat aav=0.;\n\tl=0.; expsmo=0.;\n\tfor (int i = 0; i < 11; i++) { \n\t\tp = abs(p + c) - abs(p - c) - p; \n\t\tp/= clamp(dot(p, p), .0007, 1.);\n\t\tp = p* -1.5 + c;\n\t\tif ( mod(float(i), 2.) < 1. ) { // exponential smoothing calc, with iteration skipping\n\t\t\tfloat pl = l;\n\t\t\tl = length(p);\n\t\t\texpsmo+= exp(-1. / abs(l - pl));\n\t\t\tot=min(ot, l);\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn expsmo;\n}\n\nvec3 light(vec2 p, vec3 col) {\n\t\n\t// calculate normals based on horizontal and vertical vectors being z the formula result\n\tvec2 d = vec2(0., .003);\n\tfloat d1 = formula(p - d.xy) - formula(p+d.xy);\n\tfloat d2 = formula(p - d.yx) - formula(p+d.yx);\t\n  \tvec3 n1 = vec3(0.    , d.y*2., -d1*.05);\n  \tvec3 n2 = vec3(d.y*2., 0.    , -d2*.05);\n  \tvec3 n = normalize(cross(n1, n2));\n\n\t// lighting\n\tfloat diff = pow( max(0., dot(ldir, n)) , 2.) + .2; // lambertian diffuse + ambient\n\tvec3 r = reflect(vec3(0.,0.,1.), ldir); // half vector\n\tfloat spec = pow( max(0., dot(r,n)) , 30.); // specular\n  \treturn diff*col + spec*.8;\n}\n\nvoid mainImage( out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord )\n{\n\tvec2 uv = fragCoord.xy / iResolution.xy - .5;\n\tvec2 aspect = vec2(iResolution.x / iResolution.y, 1.);\n\tuv*= aspect;\n\tvec2 pixsize = .25 / iResolution.xy * aspect; // pixel size for antialias\n\tfloat sph = length(uv); sph = sqrt(1. - sph*sph) * 1.5; // curve for spheric distortion\n\tuv = normalize(vec3(uv, sph)).xy * 1.3; // normalize back to 2D and scale (zoom level)\n\tpixsize = normalize(vec3(pixsize, sph)).xy * 1.3; // the same with pixsize for proper AA\n\n\t#ifdef SHOWLIGHT\n\tvec3 lightpos = vec3(sin(ti), cos(ti * .5), - .7); // moving light\n\t#else\n\tvec3 lightpos=vec3(0.,0.,-1.); // static light\n\t#endif\n\n\tlightpos.xy*= aspect * .25; // correct light coordinates\n\tvec3 col = vec3(0.);\n\tfloat lig = 0.;\n\tfloat titila = texture(iChannel0, vec2(ti * .25)).x; // for light intensity variation\n\n\t// AA loop\n\tfor ( float aa = 0.; aa<9. ; aa++ ) { \n\t\tvec2 aacoord = floor( vec2(aa/3., mod(aa,3.)) ); // get coord offset for AA sample\n\t\tvec2 p = uv + aacoord * pixsize; \n\t\tldir = normalize(vec3(p, .0) + lightpos); // get light direction\n\t\tfloat k = clamp(formula(p) * .25, .8, 1.4); // get value for colors in the desired range\n\t\tcol+= light(p, vec3(k, k*k, k*k*k)); // accumulate surface color (a gradient trick)\n\t\tlig+= max(0., 2. - ot) / 2.; // accumulate orbit trap (yellow lights, shared \"ot\" var)\n\t}\n\n\tcol*= .2; // correct brightness\n\tvec2 luv = uv + lightpos.xy; // uv shift by light coords\n\n\t// min amb light + spotlight with falloff * varying intensity\n\tcol*= .07 + pow( max(0., 1. - length(luv) * .5), 9. ) * (1. - titila * .3);\n\t\n\t// rotating star light\n\tfloat star = abs(1.5708 - mod(atan(luv.x, luv.y) *3. - ti * 10., 3.1416)) * .02 - .05;\n\t#ifdef SHOWLIGHT\n\tcol+= pow( max(0.,.3 - length(luv * 1.5) - star) / .3 , 5.) * (1. - titila * .5);\n\t#endif\n\t\n\t// yellow lights\n\tcol+= pow(lig * .12, 15.) * vec3(1.,.9,.3) * (.8 + BLINKINGLIGHTS * sin(ti * 5. - uv.y * 10.) * .6);\n\t\n\tfragColor = vec4(col, 1.0 );\n}\n","name":"Image","description":"","type":"image"}]},{"ver":"0.1","info":{"id":"3t3XRS","date":"1581185425","viewed":491,"name":"Alien Tech 2","username":"Kali","description":"Based on 2D Mandelbox fractal. ","likes":22,"published":1,"flags":0,"usePreview":0,"tags":[]},"renderpass":[{"inputs":[],"outputs":[{"id":"4dfGRr","channel":0}],"code":"#define aa 3\n\nmat2 rot(float a) {\n\tfloat s=sin(a);\n    float c=cos(a);\n    return mat2(c,s,-s,c);\n}\n\nvec3 fractal(vec2 p) {\n    float c=cos(iTime*.1);\n    p.x+=smoothstep(.5,1.,abs(c))*sign(c)*2.;\n    p*=.4;\n    p.y+=iTime*.05+1.5;\n\tfloat v=(floor(mod(p.y,10.))+smoothstep(.9,1.,fract(p.y)))*.1;\n    p=abs(.5-fract(p*.5));\n    vec2 m=vec2(100.);\n    float s=100.,t=s;\n    for (int i=0; i<10; i++) {\n\t\tp=abs(p+2.)-abs(p-2.)-p;\n        p.x-=3.;\n        p=p*2.5/clamp(dot(p,p),.2,1.)-1.5-v;\n        m=min(m,abs(p));\n        s=min(s,length(p*p*p)*.1);\n\t\tt=min(t,length(p));\n    }\n    s=1.-abs(.5-fract(s))*2.;\n    t=pow(max(0.,1.-t),2.);\n    s-=mod(p.x*.7+1.,16.)*.05;\n    m*=rot(-iTime+p.y*.1);\n    m=normalize(abs(m));\n\treturn vec3(m*m*3.,1.)*smoothstep(0.,3.,atan(m.x,m.y))+.3-s*s*s*10.+t;\n}\n\nvoid mainImage( out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord )\n{\n    vec2 uv = (fragCoord-iResolution.xy*.5)/iResolution.y;\n    uv.x*=sqrt(1.+uv.y);\n    uv.y*=sqrt(1.5+uv.y);\n    vec3 col = vec3(0.);    \n    for (int i=-aa; i<aa; i++) {\n        for (int j=-aa; j<aa; j++) {\n    \t\tcol+=fractal(uv+vec2(i,j)*1./iResolution.xy/float(aa));\n        }\n    }    \n    col*=(1.3-abs(uv.x))*vec3(1.,.7,.4)/float(aa*aa)*.15*smoothstep(0.,1.,iTime);\n\tcol*=max(0.2,1.-uv.y);\n    fragColor = vec4(col,1.0);\n}","name":"Image","description":"","type":"image"}]},{"ver":"0.1","info":{"id":"NldSRS","date":"1655850779","viewed":6,"name":"Almost Habitable Planets","username":"Kali","description":"I challenged myself to make a planet using only the kaliset fractal. ","likes":0,"published":2,"flags":0,"usePreview":0,"tags":[]},"renderpass":[{"inputs":[],"outputs":[{"id":"4dfGRr","channel":0}],"code":"float hash(float p)\n{\n    p*=1234.5678;\n    p = fract(p * .1031);\n    p *= p + 33.33;\n    return fract(2.*p*p);\n}\n\nvec3 hsv2rgb(vec3 c)\n{\n    vec4 K = vec4(1.0, 2.0 / 3.0, 1.0 / 3.0, 3.0);\n    vec3 p = abs(fract(c.xxx + K.xyz) * 6.0 - K.www);\n    return c.z * mix(K.xxx, clamp(p - K.xxx, 0.0, 1.0), c.y);\n}\n\n\n#define fxrand (iMouse.x/iResolution.x)\n#define hash1 hash(fxrand)\n#define hash2 hash(fxrand+.1)\n#define hash3 hash(fxrand+.2)\n#define hash4 hash(fxrand+.3)\n#define hash5 hash(fxrand+.4)\n#define hash6 hash(fxrand+.5)\n#define hash7 hash(fxrand+.6)\n#define hash8 hash(fxrand+.7)\n#define hash9 hash(fxrand+.8)\n#define hash10 hash(fxrand+.83)\n#define hash11 hash(fxrand+.84)\n#define hash12 hash(fxrand+.85)\n\nconst float det = .001;\nvec3 ldir = vec3(2., .5, -.5);\nfloat objid, objcol, coast;\nconst vec3 water_color = vec3(0., .4, .8);\nconst vec3 land_color1 = vec3(.6, 1., .5);\nconst vec3 land_color2 = vec3(.6, .2, .0);\nconst vec3 atmo_color = vec3(.4, .65, .9);\nconst vec3 cloud_color = vec3(1.3);\n\n\n#define land_color1 hsv2rgb(vec3(-.2+hash6*.4,.5,1.))\n#define land_color2 hsv2rgb(vec3(hash7*.25,.5,1.))\n#define water_color hsv2rgb(vec3(hash8*.2+.5,.5,1.))\n#define cloud_color hsv2rgb(vec3(hash9,.1,2.5))\nmat2 rot(float a) {\n\tfloat s = sin(a), c = cos(a);\n    return mat2(c, s, -s, c);\n}\n\nfloat kset(int it, vec3 p, vec3 q, float sc, float c) {\n    p.xz *= rot(iTime * .2);\n    p += q;\n    p *= sc;\n    float l = 0., l2;\n    for (int i = 0; i < it; i++) {\n    \tp = abs(p) / dot(p, p) - c;\n\t\tl += exp(-1. * abs(length(p) - l2));\n\t    l2 = length(p);\n    }\n    return l * .08;    \n}\n\nfloat clouds(vec3 p2, vec3 dir) {\n\t\tp2 -= .1 * dir;\n    \tp2.y *= 3.;\n    \tfloat cl1 = 0., cl2 = 0.;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {\n\t\t\tp2 -= .05 * dir;\n            cl1 += kset(20, p2, vec3(1.7, 3., .54), hash1*.5, .95);\n            cl2 += kset(18, p2, vec3(1.2, 1.7, 1.4), hash2*.5, .85);\n        }    \n        cl1 = pow(cl1 * .045, 10.);\n        cl2 = pow(cl2 * .055, 15.);\n\t\treturn cl1 - cl2;\n}\n\nfloat de(vec3 p) {\n    float size = hash5*1.;\n    float surf1 = kset(7, p, vec3(.523, 1.547, .754)-hash3*.5, .3, .9);\n    float surf2 = kset(9, p, vec3(.723, 1.247, .354)-hash4*.5, .2, .8) * .7;\n    float surf3 = kset(10, p, vec3(1.723, .347, .754), .3, .6) * .5;\n    objcol = pow(surf1 + surf2 + surf3, 5.)*.5;\n\tfloat land = length(p) - 2. - surf1 * .8 - surf2 * .1 - size;\n    float water = length(p) - 2.27 -size - hash10*.2;\n    float d = min(land, water);\n\tobjid = step(water, d) + step(land, d) * 2.;\n\tcoast = max(0., .03 - abs(land - water)) / .03;\n    return d * .8;\n}\n\nfloat de_clouds(vec3 p, vec3 dir) {\n    return length(p)-clouds(p, dir)*.05;\n}\n\n\nvec3 normal(vec3 p) {\n    vec3 eps = vec3(0., det, 0.);\n\treturn normalize(vec3(de(p + eps.yxx), de(p + eps.xyx), de(p + eps.xxy)) - de(p));\n}\n\nvec3 normal_clouds(vec3 p, vec3 dir) {\n    vec3 eps = vec3(0., .05, 0.);\n\tvec3 n = normalize(vec3(de_clouds(p + eps.yxx, dir), de_clouds(p + eps.xyx, dir), de_clouds(p + eps.xxy, dir)) - de_clouds(p, dir));\n\treturn n;\n}\n\nfloat shadow(vec3 desde) {\n    ldir=normalize(ldir);\n    float td=.1,sh=1.,d;\n    for (int i=0; i<10; i++) {\n\t\tvec3 p=desde+ldir*td;\n        d=de(p);\n        td+=d;\n\t\tsh=min(sh,20.*d/td);\n\t\tif (sh<.001) break;\n    }\n    return clamp(sh,0.,1.);\n}\n\nvec3 color(float id, vec3 p) {\n\tvec3 c = vec3(0.);\n    float k = smoothstep(.0, .7, kset(9, p, vec3(.63, .7, .54), .1, .8));\n    vec3 land = mix(land_color1, land_color2, k); \n    vec3 water = water_color * (objcol + .5) + coast * .7; \n\tfloat polar = pow(min(1.,abs(p.y * .4 + k * .3 - .1)),10.);\n    land = mix(land, vec3(1.), polar);\n\twater = mix(water, vec3(1.5), polar);\n    c += water * step(abs(id - 1.), .1);\n    c += land * step(abs(id - 2.), .1) * objcol * 3.;\n    return c;\n}\n\n\nvec3 shade(vec3 p, vec3 dir, vec3 n, vec3 col, float id) {\n\tldir = normalize(ldir);\n    float amb = .05;\n    float sh = shadow(p);\n    float dif = max(0., dot(ldir, n)) * .7 * sh;\n    vec3 ref = reflect(ldir, n) * sh;\n    float spe = pow(max(0., dot(ref, dir)), 10.) * .5 * (.3+step(abs(id - 1.), .1));\n    return (amb + dif) * col + spe;\n}\n\nvec3 march(vec3 from, vec3 dir) {\n\tfloat td, d, g = 0.;\n    vec3 c = vec3(0.), p;\n    for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++) {\n    \tp = from + dir * td;\n        d = de(p);\n        td += d;\n        if (td > 50. || d < det) break;\n\t\tg += smoothstep(-4.,1.,p.x);\n    }\n    if (d < det) {\n    \tp -= det * dir * 2.;\n        vec3 col = color(objid, p);\n        vec3 n = normal(p);\n        c = shade(p, dir, n, col, objid);\n        //cl1 = clamp(cl1, 0., 1.);\n        float cl1 = clouds(p, dir);\n\t\tvec3 nc = normal_clouds(p, dir);\n        c = mix(c, .1 + cloud_color * max(0., dot(normalize(ldir), nc)), clamp(cl1,0.,1.));\n    }\n    else\n    {\n        vec2 pp = dir.xy + vec2(.434, .746);\n        float m1 = 100., m2 = m1;\n        for (int i=0; i < 6; i++) {\n        \tpp = abs(pp) / dot(pp, pp) - .9;\n        \tm1 = min(m1, length(pp * vec2(4.,1.)));\n        \tm2 = min(m2, length(pp * vec2(1.,4.)));\n        }\n\t\tc += pow(max(0., 1. - m1), 30.) * .5;\t\t\n\t\tc += pow(max(0., 1. - m2), 30.) * .5;\t\t\n    }\n    g /= 60.;\n    return c + (pow(g, 1.3) + pow(g,1.7) * .5) * .5;\n}\n\n\nvoid mainImage( out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord )\n{\n    // Normalized pixel coordinates (from 0 to 1)\n    vec2 uv = (fragCoord - iResolution.xy * .5) / iResolution.y;\n\tfloat a, b;\n    vec3 from = vec3(0., a, -10.);\n\tvec3 dir = normalize(vec3(uv, min(1.1, iTime * .5)));\n    vec3 col = march(from, dir);\n    \n    // Output to screen\n    fragColor = vec4(col*.85,1.0);\n}","name":"Image","description":"","type":"image"}]},{"ver":"0.1","info":{"id":"7sKcWt","date":"0","viewed":0,"name":"Almost Habitable Planets2","username":"Kali","description":"I challenged myself to make a planet using only the kaliset fractal. \n    vec2 pixsize=1./iResolution.xy*zoo;\n    pixsize.x*=aspect;\n    float av=0.;\n    vec3 its=vec3(0.);\n    for (float aa=0.; aa<16.; aa++) {\n        vec3 otrap=vec3(1000.);\n        if (aa<antialias*antialias) {\n            vec2 aacoord=floor(vec2(aa/antialias,mod(aa,antialias)));\n            vec2 z=pos+aacoord*pixsize/antialias;\n            for (int i=0; i<iterations; i++) {\n                vec2 cz=vec2(z.x,-z.y);\n                z=z+cz/dot(z,z)+julia;\n                z=z*scale;\n                float l=length(z);\n                vec3 ot=abs(vec3(l)-orbittraps+\n                    (sin(pos.x*trapsfreq/zoo+t*trapspeeds)+\n                     sin(pos.y*trapsfreq/zoo+trapspeeds))*trapsamp);\n                if (ot.x<otrap.x) {\n                    otrap.x=ot.x;\n                    its.x=float(iterations-i);  \n                }\n                if (ot.y<otrap.y) {\n                    otrap.y=ot.y;\n                    its.y=float(iterations-i);  \n                }\n                if (ot.z<otrap.z) {\n                    otrap.z=ot.z;\n                    its.z=float(iterations-i);  \n                }\n            }\n        }\n        otrap=pow(max(vec3(0.),trapswidths-otrap)/trapswidths,trapscontrast);\n        its=its/float(iterations);\n        vec3 otcol1=otrap.x*pow(trap1color,3.5-vec3(its.x*3.))*max(minbright,its.x)*trapsbright.x;\n        vec3 otcol2=otrap.y*pow(trap2color,3.5-vec3(its.y*3.))*max(minbright,its.y)*trapsbright.y;\n        vec3 otcol3=otrap.z*pow(trap3color,3.5-vec3(its.z*3.))*max(minbright,its.z)*trapsbright.z;\n        aacolor+=(otcol1+otcol2+otcol3);\n    }\n    aacolor=aacolor/(antialias*antialias)+.15;\n    vec3 color=mix(vec3(length(aacolor)),aacolor,saturation)*brightness;\n    color=pow(color,vec3(contrast));        \n    fragColor = vec4(color,1.0);\n}","name":"Image","description":"","type":"image"}]},{"ver":"0.1","info":{"id":"7l3SWf","date":"0","viewed":0,"name":"Fractal Traps2","username":"Kali","description":"A shader I made 7 years ago with the program \"Fragmentarium\" by Syntopia. ","likes":0,"published":0,"flags":0,"usePreview":0,"tags":[]},"renderpass":[{"inputs":[],"outputs":[{"id":"4dfGRr","channel":0}],"code":"//orbit traps from julia version of fractal formula z=(z+1/z+c)*-scale;\n\n#define zoom 5.\n#define offset vec2(0.3,0.2)\n\n#define iterations 27\n#define scale -.4\n#define julia vec2(2.2,0.75)\n\n#define orbittraps vec3(.8,.5,-.01)\n#define trapswidths vec3(.2,.2,.3)\n\n#define trap1color vec3(1.00,0.30,0.10)\n#define trap2color vec3(1.00,0.50,0.10)\n#define trap3color vec3(0.10,0.20,1.00)\n\n#define trapsbright vec3(1.,.8,.7)\n#define trapscontrast vec3(5.,10.,5.)\n\n#define trapsfreq vec3(5.,8.,20.)\n#define trapsamp vec3(.03,.03,.01)\n#define trapspeeds vec3(20.,20.,40.)\n\n#define saturation .6\n#define brightness .9\n#define contrast 1.35\n#define minbright .3\n\n#define antialias 3. \n\n\n#define fxrand (iMouse.x/iResolution.x)\n#define hash1 rnd(fxrand)\n#define hash2 rnd(fxrand+.1)\n#define hash3 rnd(fxrand+.2)\n#define hash4 rnd(fxrand+.3)\n#define hash5 rnd(fxrand+.4)\n#define hash6 rnd(fxrand+.5)\n#define hash7 rnd(fxrand+.6)\n\nmat2 rot(float a)\n{\n    float s=sin(a);\n    float c=cos(a);\n    return mat2(c,s,-s,c);\n}\n\nfloat rnd(float p)\n{\n    p*=1234.5678;\n    p = fract(p * .1031);\n    p *= p + 33.33;\n    return fract(2.*p*p);\n}\n\n\nvec2 rotate(vec2 p, float angle) {\nreturn p*mat2(cos(angle),sin(angle),-sin(angle),cos(angle));\n}\n\nvoid mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, vec2 fragCoord)\n{\n    vec3 aacolor=vec3(0.);\n    vec2 uv=fragCoord / iResolution.xy - 0.5;\n    float aspect=iResolution.x/iResolution.y;\n    vec2 pos=uv;\n    pos.x*=aspect;\n    float t=iTime*.07;\n    float zoo=5.;\n    pos*=rot(hash2*6.);\n    pos+=vec2(hash3,hash4)*1.5;\n    //pos+=offset;\n    pos*=zoo; \n    //pos=mod(pos,10.);\n    vec2 pixsize=1./iResolution.xy*zoo;\n    pixsize.x*=aspect;\n    float av=0.;\n    vec3 its=vec3(0.);\n    for (float aa=0.; aa<16.; aa++) {\n        vec3 otrap=vec3(1000.);\n        if (aa<antialias*antialias) {\n            vec2 aacoord=floor(vec2(aa/antialias,mod(aa,antialias)));\n            vec2 z=pos+aacoord*pixsize/antialias;\n            for (int i=0; i<14; i++) {\n                vec2 cz=vec2(z.x,-z.y);\n                z=z+cz/dot(z,z)+julia;\n                z=z*-.3;\n                float l=length(z+vec2(hash5*.15,.0))-smoothstep(.02,.00,abs(z.y))*2.;\n                vec3 ot=abs(vec3(l)-orbittraps);\n                if (ot.x<otrap.x) {\n                    otrap.x=ot.x+max(0.,1.-iTime+z.x);\n                    its.x=float(14-i);  \n                }\n                if (ot.y<otrap.y) {\n                    otrap.y=ot.y+max(0.,1.-iTime+z.y);\n                    its.y=float(14-i);  \n                }\n                if (ot.z<otrap.z) {\n                    otrap.z=ot.z-.07+max(0.,2.-iTime+z.x+float(i)*.1);\n                    its.z=float(14-i);  \n                }\n            }\n        }\n        otrap=smoothstep(.01,.005,otrap);\n        its=its/float(iterations);\n        vec3 otcol2;\n        vec3 otcol3;\n        float ash6=hash6;\n        vec3 back=-vec3(rnd(pos.x))*.07+.02;\n        if (ash6<.3) {\n            otcol2=otrap.y*vec3(.6,.2,.0)*2.*its.y;\n            otcol3=otrap.z*vec3(.8,.5,.1);\n            back+=vec3(.05,.0,0.);\n        }\n        else if (ash6>.7) {\n            otcol2=otrap.y*vec3(.6,.5,.6)*1.5*its.y;\n            otcol3=otrap.z*vec3(.8,.5,0.);\n            back+=vec3(.0,.0,.1);\n        }\n        else {\n            otcol2=otrap.y*vec3(0.,.5,1.)*its.y*1.7;\n            otcol3=otrap.z*vec3(.6);\n            back+=.02;\n        }\n        aacolor+=max(otcol2,otcol3)+back;\n    }\n    aacolor=aacolor/(antialias*antialias)+.15;\n    vec3 color=mix(vec3(length(aacolor)),aacolor,saturation)*brightness;\n    color=pow(color,vec3(contrast));        \n    fragColor = vec4(color,1.0);\n}","name":"Image","description":"","type":"image"}]},{"ver":"0.1","info":{"id":"Xlf3zj","date":"1423215996","viewed":11,"name":"Fractal monster 2D","username":"Kali","description":"test","likes":0,"published":2,"flags":0,"usePreview":0,"tags":[]},"renderpass":[{"inputs":[{"id":"XdfGRn","filepath":"/media/a/e6e5631ce1237ae4c05b3563eda686400a401df4548d0f9fad40ecac1659c46c.jpg","previewfilepath":"/media/ap/e6e5631ce1237ae4c05b3563eda686400a401df4548d0f9fad40ecac1659c46c.jpg","type":"texture","channel":0,"sampler":{"filter":"mipmap","wrap":"repeat","vflip":"false","srgb":"false","internal":"byte"},"published":1}],"outputs":[],"code":"\n#define monster 4.\n\nmat2 r(float a) {\n    float se=sin(a), co=cos(a);\n    return mat2(se,co,co,-se);\n}\n\nfloat shape(vec2 xy, float size) {\n\treturn pow(max(0.,size-length(xy))/size,3.);\n}\n\n\nvoid mainImage( out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord )\n{\n\tvec2 uv = fragCoord.xy / iResolution.xy;\n\tvec2 xy = uv*2.-1.;\n    uv.x*=iResolution.x/iResolution.y;\n    xy.x*=iResolution.x/iResolution.y;\n\tvec2 p=xy*.5;\n\tp.y+=.4;\n    vec3 c=vec3(0.);\n\tfloat b=.1,a=3.;\n    p.x=abs(p.x);\n    for (int i=0; i<18; i++) {\n\t\tfloat l=1.5+cos(iTime*a*5.)*.5;\n        float t=monster+sin(iTime*a)*b;\n        c+=shape(p,.8)*texture(iChannel0,p+.4+vec2(0.,iTime*5.)*.2).xyz*l*.7;\n        p.x=abs(p.x); p=p*1.3-vec2(.4,0.2);\n        p*=r(t);\n\t\ta*=1.05;\n\t\tb*=.95;\n    }\n    fragColor = vec4(c,1.);\n}","name":"","description":"","type":"image"}]},{"ver":"0.1","info":{"id":"MslyRM","date":"1529084012","viewed":12,"name":"FractalMoire","username":"Kali","description":"fractal moire","likes":0,"published":2,"flags":0,"usePreview":0,"tags":[]},"renderpass":[{"inputs":[],"outputs":[{"id":"4dfGRr","channel":0}],"code":"\n#define mouse (iMouse.xy/iResolution.xy)\n\nmat2 rot(float a) {\n    float s=sin(a);\n    float c=cos(a);\n    return mat2(c,s,-s,c);\n}\n\nfloat hash(vec2 p)  // replace this by something better\n{\n    return fract(sin(length(p)*5.)*dot(mouse,1234.+mouse));\n}\n\nfloat noise( in vec2 p )\n{\n    vec2 i = floor( p );\n    vec2 f = fract( p );\n\t\n\tvec2 u = f*f*(3.0-2.0*f);\n\n    return mix( mix( hash( i + vec2(0.0,0.0) ), \n                     hash( i + vec2(1.0,0.0) ), u.x),\n                mix( hash( i + vec2(0.0,1.0) ), \n                     hash( i + vec2(1.0,1.0) ), u.x), u.y);\n}\n\n// -----------------------------------------------\n\nvoid mainImage( out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord )\n{\n    vec2 p = fragCoord.xy / iResolution.xy - .5;\n\tvec2 uv = p*vec2(iResolution.x/iResolution.y,1.0);\n\t\n\tvec3 f = vec3(0.0);\n\n\t\tuv *= 60.0;\n\t\tf  = 0.5000*noise( uv )*vec3(1.); uv = 2.*uv;\n\t\tf += 0.2500*noise( uv )*vec3(0,0.,1.); uv = 2.*uv;\n\t\tf += 0.1250*noise( uv )*vec3(0.,1.,0.); uv = 2.*uv;\n\t\tf += 0.0625*noise( uv )*vec3(1.,0.,0.); uv = 2.*uv;\n\n        f.rb*=rot(length(uv*.01)-iTime*2.);\n\n\tf = f*f*f*5.;\n\t\n\t\n\tfragColor = vec4( f, 1.0 );\n}","name":"Image","description":"","type":"image"}]},{"ver":"0.1","info":{"id":"XlsGWl","date":"1426157781","viewed":1212,"name":"Fragile","username":"Kali","description":"Raymarching glass","likes":51,"published":1,"flags":0,"usePreview":1,"tags":[]},"renderpass":[{"inputs":[{"id":"4sXGRn","filepath":"/media/a/95b90082f799f48677b4f206d856ad572f1d178c676269eac6347631d4447258.jpg","previewfilepath":"/media/ap/95b90082f799f48677b4f206d856ad572f1d178c676269eac6347631d4447258.jpg","type":"texture","channel":0,"sampler":{"filter":"mipmap","wrap":"repeat","vflip":"false","srgb":"false","internal":"byte"},"published":1}],"outputs":[],"code":"//\"Glass Field\" by Kali\n// From https://www.shadertoy.com/view/4ssGWr\n\n// boxplorer i/o\nvec3 eye, dir;\nuniform float xres, yres, speed, time;\n\n#define lightcol1 vec3(1.,.95,.85)\n#define lightcol2 vec3(.85,.95,1.)\n\n\n//Rotation matrix by Syntopia\nmat3 rotmat(vec3 v, float angle)\n{\n\tfloat c = cos(angle);\n\tfloat s = sin(angle);\n\t\n\treturn mat3(c + (1.0 - c) * v.x * v.x, (1.0 - c) * v.x * v.y - s * v.z, (1.0 - c) * v.x * v.z + s * v.y,\n\t\t(1.0 - c) * v.x * v.y + s * v.z, c + (1.0 - c) * v.y * v.y, (1.0 - c) * v.y * v.z - s * v.x,\n\t\t(1.0 - c) * v.x * v.z - s * v.y, (1.0 - c) * v.y * v.z + s * v.x, c + (1.0 - c) * v.z * v.z\n\t\t);\n}\n\n//Smooth min by IQ\nfloat smin( float a, float b, float k )\n{\n    float h = clamp( 0.5+0.5*(b-a)/k, 0.0, 1.0 );\n    return mix( b, a, h ) - k*h*(1.0-h);\n}\n\n//Distance Field\nfloat de(vec3 pos) {\n\tvec3 A=vec3(5.);\n\tvec3 p = abs(A-mod(pos,2.0*A)); //tiling fold by Syntopia\n\tfloat sph=length(p)-2.5;\n\tfloat cyl=length(p.xy)-.4;\n\tcyl=min(cyl,length(p.xz))-.4;\n\tcyl=min(cyl,length(p.yz))-.4;\n\t//cyl=min(cyl,length(p.yz-(cyl*.5)))-.4;\n    return smin(cyl,sph,1.5);\n}\n\n// finite difference normal\nvec3 normal(vec3 pos) {\n\tvec3 e = vec3(0.0,0.01,0.0);\n\t\n\treturn normalize(vec3(\n\t\t\tde(pos+e.yxx)-de(pos-e.yxx),\n\t\t\tde(pos+e.xyx)-de(pos-e.xyx),\n\t\t\tde(pos+e.xxy)-de(pos-e.xxy)\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t);\t\n}\n\n\nvoid mainImage( out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord )\n{\n\tfloat time = iTime*.6; \n\n\t//camera\n\tmat3 rotview=rotmat(normalize(vec3(1.)),sin(time*.6));\n\tvec2 coord = gl_FragCoord.xy / iResolution.xy *2. - vec2(1.);\n\tcoord.y *= iResolution.y / iResolution.x;\n\tfloat fov=min((time*.2+.05),0.8); //animate fov at start\n\tvec3 from = vec3(cos(time)*2.,sin(time*.5)*10.,time*5.);\n\n\t//raymarch\n\tfloat totdist=0.;\n\tfloat distfade=1.;\n\tfloat glassfade=1.;\n\tfloat intens=1.;\n\tfloat maxdist=50.;\n\tfloat vol=0.;\n\tvec3 spec=vec3(0.);\n\tvec3 raydir=normalize(vec3(coord.xy*fov,1.))*rotview; \n\tfloat ref=0.;\n\tvec3 light1=normalize(vec3(cos(time),sin(time*3.)*.5,sin(time)));\n\tvec3 light2=normalize(vec3(cos(time),sin(time*3.)*.5,-sin(time)));\n\n\n\tfor (int r=0; r<70; r++) {\n\t\tvec3 p=from+totdist*raydir;\n\t\tfloat d=de(p);\n\t\tfloat distfade=exp(-1.*pow(totdist/maxdist,2.));\n\t\tintens=min(distfade,glassfade);\n\t\tvec3 n=normal(p);\n\t\t// refraction\n\t\tif (d>0.0 && ref>.5) {\n\t\t\tref=0.;\n\t\t\tif (dot(raydir,n)<-.5) raydir=normalize(refract(raydir,n,1./.88));\n\t\t\tvec3 refl=reflect(raydir,n);\n\t\t\tspec+=lightcol1*pow(max(dot(refl,light1),0.0),40.)*intens*.75;\n\t\t\tspec+=lightcol2*pow(max(dot(refl,light2),0.0),40.)*intens*.75;\n\n\t\t}\n\t\tif (d<0.0 && ref<.05) {\n\t\t\tref=1.;\n\t\t\tif (dot(raydir,n)<-.05) raydir=normalize(refract(raydir,n,.88));\n\t\t\tvec3 refl=reflect(raydir,n);\n\t\t\tglassfade*=.6;\n\t\t\tspec+=lightcol1*pow(max(dot(refl,light1),0.0),40.)*intens;\n\t\t\tspec+=lightcol2*pow(max(dot(refl,light2),0.0),40.)*intens;\n\t\t}\n\t\t\n\t\ttotdist+=max(0.01,abs(d)); //advance ray \n\n\t\tvol+=intens; //accumulate current intensity\n\t}\n\ttotdist=min(maxdist,totdist);\n\tvol=pow(vol,1.5)*.0007;\n\tvec3 col=vec3(vol)+vec3(spec)*.4+vec3(.05);\n\n\t//lights\n\tcol*=min(1.5,time); //fade in\n\n  fragColor=vec4(col,1.);  // boxplorify write\n}\n\n\n","name":"Image","description":"","type":"image"}]},{"ver":"0.1","info":{"id":"XcXXzS","date":"1705369628","viewed":19774,"name":"Full Spectrum Cyber","username":"Kali","description":"Made for Genuary 2024 day 10 - prompt: Hexagonal\nupdate 2024-01-24: thanks to Shane for the new sphere-mapping","likes":266,"published":1,"flags":0,"usePreview":1,"tags":[]},"renderpass":[{"inputs":[],"outputs":[{"id":"4dfGRr","channel":0}],"code":"// comments below are by Shane, thanks!\n\nint hexid;\nvec3 hpos, point, pt;\nfloat tcol, bcol, hitbol, hexpos, fparam=0.;\n\nmat2 rot(float a) {\n    float s=sin(a),c=cos(a);\n    return mat2(c,s,-s,c);\n}\n\nvec3 path(float t) {\n    return vec3(sin(t*.3+cos(t*.2)*.5)*4.,cos(t*.2)*3.,t);\n}\n\nfloat hexagon( in vec2 p, in float r )\n{\n    const vec3 k = vec3(-0.866025404,0.5,0.577350269);\n    p = abs(p);\n    p -= 2.0*min(dot(k.xy,p),0.0)*k.xy;\n    p -= vec2(clamp(p.x, -k.z*r, k.z*r), r);\n    return length(p)*sign(p.y);\n}\n\nfloat hex(vec2 p) {\n    p.x *= 0.57735*2.0;\n\tp.y+=mod(floor(p.x),2.0)*0.5;\n\tp=abs((mod(p,1.0)-0.5));\n\treturn abs(max(p.x*1.5 + p.y, p.y*2.0) - 1.0);\n}\n\nmat3 lookat(vec3 dir) {\n    vec3 up=vec3(0.,1.,0.);\n    vec3 rt=normalize(cross(dir,up));\n    return mat3(rt, cross(rt,dir), dir);\n}\n\nfloat hash12(vec2 p)\n{\n\tp*=1000.;\n\tvec3 p3  = fract(vec3(p.xyx) * .1031);\n    p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 33.33);\n    return fract((p3.x + p3.y) * p3.z);\n}\n\n/////////////////\n/*\n// Renders a line between points A and B on a sphere. Very handy.\n// I have a faster function without caps, but this will do.\nfloat sphereLineCapAB2(vec3 p, vec3 a, vec3 b, float rad){\n \n     \n     p /= rad; // Normalize p.\n     \n     float ln = dot(p, cross(a, b))/length(a - b);\n     \n     vec3 perpA = a + cross(b - a, a);\n     vec3 perpB = b + cross(a - b, b);\n     float endA = dot(p, cross(perpA, a))/length(perpA - a);\n     float endB = dot(p, cross(perpB, b))/length(perpB - b);\n     \n     return sign(ln)*max(max(abs(ln), endA), endB);\n      \n}\n*/\n\n// Renders a line between points A and B on a sphere with no capping. \nfloat sphereLineAB(vec3 p, vec3 a, vec3 b, float rad){\n     \n     p = normalize(p); // Normalize p. // Set radius: p /= rad; \n     return dot(p, cross(a, b))/length(a - b);\n\n}\n\n\n// Rotate on axis.\n// Blackle https://suricrasia.online/demoscene/functions/\n// Point to rotate, point to rotate around, and rotation angle.\nvec3 erot(vec3 p, vec3 ax, float ro) {\n  return mix(dot(ax, p)*ax, p, cos(ro)) + sin(ro)*cross(ax, p);\n}\n\n#define PI 3.14159265359\n#define PHI (1. + sqrt(5.))/2.\n// Closest icosahedron face center, and face verts. Just a slight rewriting\n// of one of TdHooper's function -- Actually, he was kind enough to write this\n// one for me. Obviously, it's more complicated than selecting cube faces, but\n// it involves the same process, which is stepping on either side of planes.\nvoid icosahedronVerts(in vec3 p, out vec3 face, out vec3 a, out vec3 b, out vec3 c) {\n    \n    // Icosaheral Vertices.\n    vec3 V = vec3(PHI, 1,  0);\n    vec3 ap = abs(p), v = V;\n    if (dot(ap, V.yzx - v) > 0.) v = V.yzx;\n    if (dot(ap, V.zxy - v) > 0.) v = V.zxy;\n    a = normalize(v)*sign(p);\n    \n    // Dodecahedron vertices. Icosahedrons and dodecahedrons are duals, so\n    // the dodecahedral vertices align to the center of the icosahedron cells,\n    // which is pretty handy, since we need the cell center. :)\n    v = V.xxx;\n    V = vec3(V.zy, V.x + V.y);\n    if (dot(ap, V - v) > 0.) v = V;\n    if (dot(ap, V.yzx - v) > 0.) v = V.yzx;\n    if (dot(ap, V.zxy - v) > 0.) v = V.zxy;\n    face = normalize(v)*sign(p);\n   \n    float r = PI*2./3.;\n    \n    // You can skip this if you don't care about the 2nd vert\n    // always being the 2nd closest\n    //float side = boolSign(dot(p, cross(a, face))); r *= side;\n    \n    // Rotating the icosahedron vertex around the cell center by TAU/3 will \n    // give you one of the other vertices, and rotating the other way produces \n    // the other. Obvious... once someone provides the answer. :D\n    //\n    // Point to rotate, point to rotate around, and rotation angle.\n    b = erot(a, face, -r);\n    c = erot(a, face, r);\n    \n \n}\n//////////////////////\nfloat de(vec3 p) {\n    pt=vec3(p.xy-path(p.z).xy,p.z);\n    float h=abs(hexagon(pt.xy,3.+fparam));\n    hexpos=hex(pt.yz);\n    tcol=smoothstep(.0,.15,hexpos);\n    h-=tcol*.1;\n    vec3 pp=p-hpos;\n    pp=lookat(point)*pp;\n    pp.y-=abs(sin(iTime))*3.+(fparam-(2.-fparam));\n    pp.yz*=rot(-iTime);\n    \n    float bola=length(pp)-1.;\n    \n    // This is a hack to gain some extra speed. The idea being that\n    // we shouldn't attempt to map the sphere, if we're not close \n    // enough to it. I don't quite trust it, but it seems to work.\n    if(length(pp)<1.5){\n    \n        ////////////////////\n        // Icosahedron face and vertices.\n        vec3 face;\n        vec3[3] v;\n        icosahedronVerts(pp, face, v[0], v[1], v[2]);\n        float rad = 1.; // Sphere radius.\n\n        // Two points on either side of each triangle edge midpoint. There\n        // are six in all. Connecting all six lines will form a hexagon in\n        // the middle of the icosahedral triangle.\n        //\n        // I made this up on the spot, so there are probably better ways\n        // to do it. However, I'm not aware of space folding techniques\n        // that can achieve this pattern. Someone like TdHooper, knighty,\n        // MLA, or Djinn Kahn might, however.\n        vec3[6] mid;\n        for(int i = 0; i<3; i++){\n            mid[i*2] = mix(v[i], v[(i + 1)%3], 1./3.);\n            mid[i*2 + 1] = mix(v[i], v[(i + 1)%3], 2./3.);\n        }\n        // Constructing a hexagon in the triangle face center.\n        float poly = -1e5;\n        for(int i = 0; i<6; i++){\n           poly = max(poly, sphereLineAB(pp, mid[i], mid[(i + 1)%6], rad));\n\n        }\n        // Taking the absolute will fill in the outside. This saves rendering\n        // more polygons.\n        bcol = smoothstep(0., .05, abs(poly));\n        bola += bcol*.1;\n    \n    }\n    /////////////////\n    vec3 pr=p;\n    pr.z=mod(p.z,6.)-3.;\n    float d=min(h,bola);\n    if (d==bola) {\n        tcol=1.;\n        hitbol=1.;\n    }\n    else {\n        hitbol=0.;\n        bcol=1.;\n    }\n    return d*.5;\n}\n\nvec3 floor(p);\n\tfloat v = p.x+p.y*1000.0;\n\tvec4 r = vec4(v, v+1., v+1000.0, v+1001.);\n\tr = fract(12345.*sin(r*.001));\n\tf = f*f*(3.0-2.0*f);\n\treturn 2.0*(mix(mix(r.x, r.y, f.x), mix(r.z, r.w, f.x), f.y))-1.0;\n}\n\n\nfloat terrain( vec2 p) {\n\tfloat h = 0.0; \n\tfloat w = .5; \n\tfloat m = .5; \n\tfor (int i=0; i<5; i++) {\n\t\th += w * snoise((p * m));\n\t\tw *= .25;\n\t\tm *= 4.;\n\t}\n IA-63 Pampa is an advanced jet trainer produced in Argentina. The painting is my own design. \nEach flight is 4 minutes long, from river to lake, with different terrain and movements at each iteration. \nMouse enabled.","likes":0,"published":2,"flags":0,"usePreview":0,"tags":[]},"renderpass":[{"inputs":[],"outputs":[{"id":"4dfGRr","channel":0}],"code":"#define trail\n#define letterboxfullscreen\n//#define noplane\n//#define onlymouse\n\n/*\n\nABOUT THIS SHADER\n\nLately I've been posting my demoscene intros and some small \nand quickly made shaders, but it's been a long time since \nI've made a big and elaborate shader exclusively for Shadertoy. \nI realized that the site will be 10 years old soon, as well as \nthe first shader I published here, so as an early celebration \nI decided to dedicate a lot of time and effort to this new work. \n\nLately I have renewed my passion for airplanes, so I came up with \nthe idea of modeling the Pampa III, a jet trainer manufactured in \nmy country. I relied on some photos but what it was really helpful was\nthese blueprint-like drawings I found on the manufacturer's website. \nI think the result looks pretty similar, except that I didn't like \nthe original paint designs much so I created my own.\n\nOriginally the shader was going to just show the plane, starting \nwith the same green scene at the beginning. But I really wanted \nit to take off. I don't usually do landscape shaders, so I thought \nit was a good idea to make it fly over some mountains and along a river. \nTo generate all the terrain I used a 2D noise function by Trisomie21 \nwhich is quick and simple. for the river I dug a trench in the ground \nwith an exp function, and then added a reflective surface at a certain\nheight. Later the terrain sinks further and forms something like a lake \nwith clearer water. The clouds are made using a classic 3D fbm.\n\nThe movement of the plane and the camera is handled pseudo-randomly \nby a function that interpolates hashes. There is also a semi-fixed \ncamera that sometimes shows the plane passing by at full speed. \n\nThe last thing I added was the contrail. It was a pain in the ass to get\nit right, but I'm really happy with the result. \n\nThe duration of the scene is 4 minutes and then restarts. But the seed \nof the hashes keeps changing so the scenery and movements vary with \neach iteration.\n\nSorry I didn't comment the spaghetti code, but do you really want to get \ninto that mess? \n\nBtw, I tried to optimize it as much as I could, but for full screen you need \na good GPU. I decided to put a default letterbox mode on fullscreen. and \non my 1660ti the framerate ranges between 40 and 50 fps, so it should work\nfine on newer cards. It takes about 15 seconds to compile for me.\n\nSo this is it, I hope you enjoy it. Thanks to Beautypi and all the community \nfor so many years of amazing stuff!\n\nWith love, \n\nKali. \n\n*/\n\n#define time mod(iTime*.83,200.)\n#define resolution iResolution\n\nfloat The painting is my own design. \nEach flight is 4 minutes long, from river to lake, with different terrain and movements at each iteration. \nMouse enabled.","likes":0,"published":0,"flags":0,"usePreview":0,"tags":[]},"renderpass":[{"inputs":[],"outputs":[{"id":"4dfGRr","channel":0}],"code":"#define trail\n#define letterboxfullscreen\n#define noplane\n//#define onlymouse\n\n/*\n\nABOUT THIS SHADER\n\nIt's been a while since I made a big elaborated shader exclusively for \nShadertoy. I realized the site will be 10 years old soon, and it's been\na decade already since I started coding shaders myself. \nSo I worked hard on this project to celebrate that :)\n\nLately I have renewed my love for airplanes, so I came up with \nthe idea of modeling the Pampa III, a jet trainer manufactured in \nmy country. I relied on some photos but what was really helpful was\nthe blueprint-like drawings I found on the manufacturer's website. \nI think the result looks pretty similar, except that I didn't like \nthe original paint designs much so I created my own.\n\nOriginally the shader was going to be just the plane model, but then I really \nwanted it to take off. I don't usually do landscape shaders, so I thought \nit was a good idea to make it fly over some mountains and along a river. \nTo generate all the terrain I used a 2D noise function by Trisomie21 \nwhich is fast and simple. for the river I dug a trench in the ground \nwith an exp function, and then added a reflective surface at a certain\nheight. Later the terrain sinks further and forms something like a lake \nwith clearer water. The clouds are made using a classic 3D fbm.\n\nThe movement of the plane and the camera is handled pseudo-randomly \nby a function that interpolates hashes. There is also a semi-fixed \ncamera that sometimes shows the plane passing by at full speed. \n\nThe last thing I added was the contrail. I tried a lot of things and it\nwas a pain to get it right, but I'm really happy with the result. \n\nThe duration of each flight is 4 minutes and then restarts. But the hashes \nkeep changing so the terrain configuration, camera and airplane movements \nvary with each iteration.\n\nCode is awful, spaghetti and uncommented. Sorry and good luck if you want \nto get into that mess.   \n\nBtw, I tried to optimize it as much as I could, but for full screen you need \na pretty decent GPU. I decided to put a default letterbox mode on full screen,\nand on my 1660 ti the framerate ranges between 40 and 50 fps, so it should \nwork fine on newer cards. It takes about 15 seconds to compile for me.\n\nSo this is it, I hope you enjoy it! \n\nWith love, \n\nKali. \n\n*/\n\n#define time mod(iTime*.83,200.)\n#define resolution iResolution\n\nfloat hashseed=0.;\nfloat det=.01;\nfloat maxdist=40.;\nvec3 objcol;\nvec3 ldir;\nfloat id,oc=1.,dcab,t,h,speed,baja,ref;\nvec3 pos, pfus, pmot, pcab, parm, pwin, ptim, ptai, tpos;\nvec3 ppos=vec3(0.),ppos2=vec3(0.);\nmat2 rotyz, rotxy, rotxz;\nfloat hash(float p) { p = fract(p * 0.011); p *= p + 7.5; p *= p + p; return fract(p); }\nfloat hash(vec2 p) {vec3 p3 = fract(vec3(p.xyx) * 0.13); p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 3.333); return fract((p3.x + p3.y) * p3.z); }\n\nfloat interhash(float seed, float t) {\n    t+=hash(seed+hashseed)*123.;\n    return mix(hash(floor(t)),hash(floor(t+1.)),smoothstep(.3,1.,fract(t)));\n}\n\nfloat path(float t) {\n    return sin(t+cos(t*.5687))*.5;\n}\n\n\nmat2 rot(float a) {\n    float s=sin(a),c=cos(a);\n    return mat2(c,s,-s,c);\n}\n\n\nfloat smin( float a, float b, float k )\n{\n    float h = max( k-abs(a-b), 0.0 )/k;\n    return min( a, b ) - h*h*k*(1.0/4.0);\n}\n\nfloat ssub ( float d1, float d2, float k ) {\n    float h = clamp( 0.5 - 0.5*(d2+d1)/k, 0.0, 1.0 );\n    return mix( d2, -d1, h ) + k*h*(1.0-h); }\n\nfloat box( vec3 p, vec3 b, float r )\n{\n  vec3 q = abs(p) - b;\n  return length(max(q,0.0)) + min(max(q.x,max(q.y,q.z)),0.0) - r;\n}\n\nfloat capsule( vec3 p, float h, float r )\n{\n  p.z -= clamp( p.z, 0.0, h );\n  return length( p ) - r;\n}\n\nfloat elipse( vec3 p, vec3 r )\n{\n  float k0 = length(p/r);\n  float k1 = length(p/(r*r));\n  return k0*(k0-1.0)/k1;\n}\n\nfloat cabina(vec3 p) {\n    p.z+=1.9;\n    p.y-=1.;\n    p.y+=pow(max(0.,-p.z+1.)*.31,2.);\n    p.y-=pow(max(0.,-p.z+3.5)*.3,1.5)*.1;\n    float d=elipse(p,vec3(.35,.5,2.9));\n    pcab=p;\n    dcab=d;\n    return d*.8;\n}\n\n\nfloat fuselaje(vec3 p) {\n    float cab=cabina(p);\n    vec3 p2=p;\n    p.z+=5.5;\n    p.y-=smoothstep(2.,0.,p.z)*.2*abs(p.y);\n    p.y-=smoothstep(0.,4.,p.z)*.3;\n    p.y*=1.+smoothstep(4.,0.,p.z)*.2;\n    p.y-=smoothstep(2.,5.2,p.z)*.5*max(0.,p.y);\n t=vec3(.55,.7,5.5);\n    t.y*=1.-smoothstep(2.,11.,p.z)*.4;\n    p.x*=1.+smoothstep(8.,9.,p.z)*.25;\n    p.z-=5.5;\n    float d=elipse(p,t);\n    pfus=p;\n    p2.y+=.1;\n    d=max(d,-length(p2.xy)+.7*step(0.,p2.z));\n    oc*=step(0.,d+.2);\n    d=max(d,-cab);\n    return d*.5;\n}\n\nfloat motor(vec3 p) {\n    p*=1.05;\n    p.z-=.4;\n    p.y-=.25+exp(-5.*abs(p.x))*.1*smoothstep(2.,0.,p.z)+p.z*.03;\n    float h=length(pow(abs(p.xy),vec2(1.5))*vec2(1,3.))-.62+max(0.,p.z+1.);\n    h=min(h,length(p.xy)-.27);\n    float sc=1.+min(2.,pow(max(0.,p.z+2.3)*.23,3.));\n    p.x*=sc;\n    p.y*=1.+min(.5,pow(abs(p.z)*.37,6.));\n    p.y*=1.+min(1.,pow(max(0.,p.z+1.),2.)*.05);\n    p.x*=1.+min(1.,pow(abs(p.y),2.5));\n    float d=box(p,vec3(.65,.45,2.3),.2+max(0.,p.z)*.05);\n    oc*=max(0.,sign(d+.1));\n    d=ssub(h,d,.1*step(0.,-p.z));\n    pmot=p;\n    return d*.8/sc;\n}\n\nfloat alas(vec3 p) {\n    p.y-=1.2-abs(p.x)*.07;\n    p.z-=.3;\n    p.x+=smoothstep(0.,1.8,-p.z)*sign(p.x);\n    float w=abs(p.x)*.1;\n    p.y*=.7+min(1.5,pow(abs(p.z+.3),3.)+abs(p.x)*.3);\n    float d=box(p,vec3(4.5,-.1,.9-w),.2);\n    p.z+=w;\n    pwin=p;\n    return d*.4;\n}\n\nfloat cola(vec3 p) {\n    p.y-=1.-abs(p.x)*.15;\n    p.z-=4.;\n    p.z-=abs(p.x)*.3*smoothstep(-.2,0.2,-p.z);\n    float w=abs(p.x)*.1;\n    p.y*=.7+min(1.,pow(abs(p.z+.3),3.)+abs(p.x)*.5);\n    float d=box(p,vec3(1.7,-.13,.5),.2);\n    ptai=p;\n    return d*.5;\n}\n\nfloat timon(vec3 p) {\n    p.y-=1.;\n    p.z-=3.8;\n    p.z-=p.y*(step(p.z-.5,0.)+1.)*.4;;\n    float d=box(p,vec3(-.05-p.z*.02,1.5,.8),.1);\n    d=max(d,-p.y);\n    ptim=p;\n    return d*.5;\n\n}\n\nfloat arma1(vec3 p) {\n    p.y-=.3;\n    float b=box(p-vec3(0,0,p.y*.5),vec3(.0,.2,.35),0.05);\n    p.y+=.3;\n    p.z+=.9;\n    p.z-=length(p.xy)*.5;\n    float c=capsule(p,1.3,.23);\n    float d=min(b,c);\n    objcol+=max(0.,sign(.1-d))*vec3(1,0,0);\n    return d*.5;\n}\n\n\nfloat armas(vec3 p) {\n    vec3 p2=p;\n    p.x=abs(p.x)-1.5;\n    p.y-=.7;\n    p2.x=abs(p2.x)-2.;\n    p2.z-=.2;\n    p2.y-=.45;\n    float ar2=arma1(p2);\n    parm=p2;\n    return ar2;\n}\n\n// Simple noise algorithm by Trisomie21\nfloat snoise( vec2 p ) {\n    p.y-=hashseed*100.;\n    p.xy=p.yx;\n\tvec2 f = fract(p);\n\tp = floor(p);\n\tfloat v = p.x+p.y*1000.0;\n\tvec4 r = vec4(v, v+1., v+1000.0, v+1001.);\n\tr = fract(12345.*sin(r*.001));\n\tf = f*f*(3.0-2.0*f);\n\treturn 2.0*(mix(mix(r.x, r.y, f.x), mix(r.z, r.w, f.x), f.y))-1.0;\n}\n\n\nfloat terrain( vec2 p) {\n\tfloat h = 0.0; \n\tfloat w = .5; \n\tfloat m = .5; \n\tfor (int i=0; i<5; i++) {\n\t\th += w * snoise((p * m));\n\t\tw *= .25;\n\t\tm *= 4.;\n\t}\n\t//return h*(1.+snoise(p*.1)*.7);\n    return h;\n}\n\nfloat terrain(vec3 p) {\n    if (p.y>2.) return p.y+2.;\n    p.z+=time*3.;\n    p.y+=.3+smoothstep(120.*3.,130.*3.,p.z)*.75;\n    p.x-=path(p.z);\n\th = terrain(p.xz*vec2(.5,1.)) * 1.2;\n\th += smoothstep(-0.3, 1.5, h);\n\tfloat ap=.3+max(0.,sin(p.z*.05+cos(p.z*.123)*.0))*.5;\n    h=mix(h,-1.,exp(-ap*(abs(p.x-.5*snoise(p.zz*.5)))));\n\tfloat d = p.y - h;\t\n    tpos=p;\n\treturn d*.5;\n}\n\nfloat pampa(vec3 p) {\n    p.z+=2.8;\n    p.y-=.8;\n    p.yz*=rotyz;\n    p.xz*=rotxz;\n    p.z-=2.8;\n    p.y+=.8;\n    p.xy*=rotxy;\n    float bound=box(p,vec3(5.,3.,6.),0.);\n#ifdef noplane\n    bound=box(p,vec3(1.,1.,2.3),0.);id=1.;return bound;\n#endif\n    if (bound>.65) return bound+.65;\n    objcol=vec3(1.);\n    p.z*=-1.05;\n    float fus=fuselaje(p);\n    float mot=motor(p);\n    float win=alas(p);\n    float tai=cola(p);\n    float tim=timon(p);\n    float d=min(d,arm);\n    if (d==fus) id=0.;\n    if (d==mot) id=1.;\n    if (d==cab) id=2.;\n    if (d==win) id=3.;\n    if (d==tai) id=4.;\n    if (d==tim) id=5.;\n    if (d==arm) id=6.;\n    float t=step(abs(pcab.z+.3-pcab.y*.5),.07);\n    t=max(t,step(abs(pcab.z+1.4+pcab.y*.3),.05));\n    id-=step(1.,t);\n    id=max(0.,id);\n    pos=p;\n    return d*1.2;\n}\n\n\nfloat water(vec3 p) {\n    p.z+=time*3.*1.5;\n    p.x-=path(p.z);\n    p.x*=2.;\n    return (p.y+1.75+snoise(p.xz*20.+time*0.)*.0002)*.9;\n}\n\nvec2 contrail(vec3 p) {\n    vec3 pp=p-ppos;\n    float t2=(tpos.z/3.)*speed-2.+.04*speed;\n    //t2=mix(t,t2,pow(clamp((-pp.z-.16)*3.,0.,1.),.3));\n    float chx=(interhash(0.,t2)-.5)*4.5;\n    float chy=.8+(interhash(-10.,t2*.75)-.5)*1.5+.018-baja;\n    float w=.003+min(.05,-pp.z*.005)*2.;\n    //w=.01+smoothstep(0.,-15.,pp.z)*.1;\n    w=min(.03,w);\n    float chorro=length(p.xy-vec2(chx,chy))-snoise(tpos.zz*15.)*w*.4;\n    chorro=max(.003,abs(chorro));\n    chorro=max(chorro,pp.z+.1);\n    chorro=max(chorro,-pp.z-14.);\n    return vec2(chorro,w);\n}\n\n\nfloat de(vec3 p) {\n    vec3 pos=p-ppos;\n    float The painting is my own design. \nEach flight is 4 minutes long, from river to lake, with different terrain and movements at each iteration. \nMouse enabled.","likes":0,"published":2,"flags":0,"usePreview":0,"tags":[]},"renderpass":[{"inputs":[],"outputs":[{"id":"4dfGRr","channel":0}],"code":"#define trail\n#define letterboxfullscreen\n//#define noplane\n//#define onlymouse\n\n/*\n\nABOUT THIS SHADER\n\nIt's been a while since I made a big elaborated shader exclusively for \nShadertoy. I realized the site will be 10 years old soon, and it's been\na decade already since I started with shaders myself. \nSo I worked hard on this project to celebrate that :)\n\nLately I have renewed my love for airplanes, so I came up with \nthe idea of modeling the Pampa III, a jet trainer manufactured in \nmy country. I relied on some photos but what was really helpful was\nthe blueprint-like drawings I found on the manufacturer's website. \nI think the result looks pretty similar, except that I didn't like \nthe original paint designs much so I created my own.\n\nOriginally the shader was going to just show the plane, starting \nwith the same green hud scene at the beginning. But I really wanted \nit to take off. I don't usually do landscape shaders, so I thought \nit was a good idea to make it fly over some mountains and along a river. \nTo generate all the terrain I used a 2D noise function by Trisomie21 \nwhich is fast and simple. for the river I dug a trench in the ground \nwith an exp function, and then added a reflective surface at a certain\nheight. Later the terrain sinks further and forms something like a lake \nwith clearer water. The clouds are made using a classic 3D fbm.\n\nThe movement of the plane and the camera is handled pseudo-randomly \nby a function that interpolates hashes. There is also a semi-fixed \ncamera that sometimes shows the plane passing by at full speed. \n\nThe last thing I added was the contrail. I tried a lot of things and it\nwas a pain to get it right, but I'm really happy with the result. \n\nThe duration of each flight is 4 minutes and then restarts. But the hashes \nkeep changing so the terrain configuration, camera and airplane movements \nvary with each iteration.\n\nCode is awful, spaghetti and uncommented. Sorry and good luck if you want \nto get into that mess.   \n\nBtw, I tried to optimize it as much as I could, but for full screen you need \na pretty decent GPU. I decided to put a default letterbox mode on full screen,\nand on my 1660 ti the framerate ranges between 40 and 50 fps, so it should \nwork fine on newer cards. It takes about 15 seconds to compile for me.\n\nSo this is it, I hope you enjoy it. Thanks to Beautypi and all the community \nfor so many years of amazing stuff!\n\nWith love, \n\nKali. \n\n*/\n\n#define time mod(iTime*.83,200.)\n#define resolution iResolution\n\nfloat 0.13); p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 3.333); return fract((p3.x + p3.y) * p3.z); }\n\nfloat interhash(float seed, float t) {\n    t+=hash(seed+hashseed)*123.;\n    return mix(hash(floor(t)),hash(floor(t+1.)),smoothstep(.3,1.,fract(t)));\n}\n\nfloat path(float t) {\n    return sin(t+cos(t*.5687))*.5;\n}\n\n\nmat2 rot(float a) {\n    float s=sin(a),c=cos(a);\n    return p.y-=pow(max(0.,-p.z+3.5)*.3,1.5)*.1;\n    float d=elipse(p,vec3(.35,.5,2.9));\n    pcab=p;\n    dcab=d;\n    return d*.8;\n}\n\n\nfloat fuselaje(vec3 p) {\n    float cab=cabina(p);\n    vec3 p2=p;\n D 6\n\nfloat hash(vec2 p)\n{\n   return fract(sin(dot(p, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453);\n}\n\n// funcion que chequea en los pixeles aledaños a la pos actual si \n// hay una particula que llega a este pixel segun su pos+velocidad\nfloat arrivingParticle(vec2 coord, out vec4 partData) {\n\t// recorre un area de -D a D\n    for (int i=-D; i<D; i++) {\n        for (int j=-D; j<D; j++) {\n            // posicion a chequear\n            vec2 arrCoord = coord + vec2(i,j);\n            vec4 data = texture(iChannel0, arrCoord/iResolution.xy);\n            \n            // no hay particulas aqui, saltear\n            if (dot(data,data)<.1) continue;\n\n            // guarda proxima posicion de la particula en nextCoord\n            vec2 nextCoord = data.xy + data.zw;\n\n            // vector distancia entre la proxima posición de esta particula\n            // y la actual coordenada\n            vec2 offset = abs(coord - nextCoord);\n            // si está dentro del pixel, elegir los datos de esta partícula \n            // para setear en el próximo frame\n            // si había otras que lleguen se van a perder\n            // (es la contra de este método)\n            if (offset.x<.5 && offset.y<.5) {\n                partData = data;\n                return 1.;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    // no llegan partículas\n\treturn 0.;\n}\n\nvoid mainImage( out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord )\n{\n\tvec2 uv = fragCoord/iResolution.xy;\n \t// generar particulas random en la parte superior, xy es la pos, zw es la velocidad\n    if (fragCoord.y>iResolution.y-3.) {\n        fragColor = vec4(fragCoord.xy,(hash(uv+iTime)-.8)*4.,-6.+hash(uv)); \n        return;\n    }\n   \n    // ver si va a llegar una particula a este pixel y guardar sus datos en partData\n    vec4 partData;\n    float p = arrivingParticle(fragCoord, partData);\n\n    // no hay particulas llegando a este pixel, borrarlo\n    if (p<1.) {\n    \tfragColor = vec4(0.);\n        return;\n    }\n    \n    // factor de velocidad segun el brillo de los canales rb de la textura\n    float vel=max(0.,1.-length(texture(iChannel2,fragCoord/iResolution.xy).rb)*.95);\n\n    // actualiza la posicion de la particula segun su vector de velocidad en zw, \n    // multiplicado por vel para hacerlas mas lentas segun el brillo\n    partData.xy+=partData.zw*vel;\n\n    //setea en fragColor los datos de la 1.0);\n    float theta = 2.0 * PI * u;\n    float phi = acos(2.0 * v - 1.0);\n\n    vec3 randomDir;\n    randomDir.x = sin(phi) * cos(theta);\n    randomDir.y = sin(phi) * sin(theta);\n    randomDir.z = cos(phi);\n\n    // Transformar a coordenadas locales\n    vec3 up = abs(normal.z) < 0.999 ? vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0) : vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);\n    vec3 tangent = normalize(cross(up, normal));\n    vec3
